args.description: The command and its arguments of a run node (after args_prefix). They are not given to a shell: the first one is looked up in the PATH of the runner. It is not inherited. Variables can be used.

args_prefix.description: Arguments that are put before the args of the run nodes in this subtree, e.g. ["ssh", "root@{server}"]. Its variables are the ones of the node that sets it. Inherited from the parent node.

children_on_error.description: The on_error value that the sub-nodes inherit (when they do not specify on_error). When it is not given, the sub-nodes inherit the on_error of the node.

else.patternErrorMessage: expected a status (failed, paused, success) and/or a sibling operation (none, skip, freeze), e.g. paused or "failed, freeze"

collapse_on_finished.description: Collapse the node in the GUI when it finishes. Default: true.

cwd.description: The directory where the processes are started. When it is empty, the current directory of the runner is used (runtree's own for the local runner, the home directory for an ssh runner). ~ is not expanded, a cwd that starts with ~ is an error. Inherited from the parent node.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file). A node that includes one object (without for_vars and locks) becomes that object, with its own title, description, provides and requires.

def_vars.description: Default variable values: only used when the variable is not inherited from the parent. A variable cannot be in both vars and def_vars.

description.description: Multi-line description of the node, displayed in the GUI when the node is selected.

envs.description: Environment variables (name: value) for the processes of this subtree. The values can use variables, and {NAME} of the inherited envs. Inherited from the parent node.

expand_on_active.description: Expand the node in the GUI when it becomes active. Default: true.

expanded.description: Display the sub-nodes of the node in the GUI when the tree is loaded. Default: false.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file). A node that includes one object (without for_vars and locks) becomes that object, with its own title, description, provides and requires.

for_vars.description: Repeat the sub-nodes for every combination of the listed variable values (lists of strings, or names of list variables). The first variable changes the slowest.

id.description: Identifier of the node, it must match [a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]* and be unique in the tree. A generated id is used when it is not given.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file). A node that includes one object (without for_vars and locks) becomes that object, with its own title, description, provides and requires.

ifeq.description: Include the node only if all of the given variables have the given values (an undefined variable is empty).

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file). A node that includes one object (without for_vars and locks) becomes that object, with its own title, description, provides and requires.

ifneq.description: Include the node only if all of the given variables differ from the given values (an undefined variable is empty).

include.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file). A node that includes one object (without for_vars and locks) becomes that object, with its own title, description, provides and requires.

inherit_envs.description: Inherit the environment variables (envs) of the parent node. Default: true.

inherit_vars.description: Inherit the variables of the parent node. When it is false, the node only has its own variables and the for_vars of its parent; def_vars cannot be used then. Default: true.

max_proc.description: Maximum number of running processes in this subtree; a negative value means no limit, 0 starts nothing. It is inherited: a sub-node limits its own subtree with the same number. Inherited from the parent node. Default: -1.

nodes.description: The sub-nodes of a seq or par node.

else.description: a run node, given as a list of arguments

on_error.description: What to do when the process or a sub-node fails: the status of the node (failed, paused or success) and/or an operation on the not yet started siblings (none, skip or freeze), e.g. paused, [paused, freeze] or "paused, freeze". The part that is not given is the default (failed, none). Inherited from the parent's children_on_error, or from its on_error. Inherited from the parent node. Default: failed.

else.patternErrorMessage: expected a status (failed, paused, success) and/or a sibling operation (none, skip, freeze), e.g. paused or "failed, freeze"

par.description: Sub-nodes that run in parallel (this makes the node a par node).

else.description: a run node, given as a list of arguments

provides.description: Names of resources that are provided when the node finishes without an error (success, or skipped). The nodes that require them wait until then. It is not inherited.

requires.description: Names of resources that must be provided (by other nodes) before the node can be started. It is not inherited.

rlocks.description: Names of resources that are locked while the node is running or paused. The topmost node that lists a name holds it, its subtree shares it, other nodes cannot lock it meanwhile. It is inherited, the node's own rlocks replace the inherited ones. Inherited from the parent node.

runner.description: The runner that runs the processes of the node: local (runtree runs them itself), the address (host:port or tcp://host:port) of an rtrunner, or ssh://[user@]host[:port][/path/to/rtrunner] (ssh starts rtrunner on the host for each process). When it is not set, it is inherited from the parent; the default of the root is local, or the --runner option of runtree. Inherited from the parent node. Default: local.

seq.description: Sub-nodes that run one after the other (this makes the node a seq node).

else.description: a run node, given as a list of arguments

status.description: The initial status of the node. A frozen node is not started until it is thawed manually. It is inherited: the sub-nodes of a frozen seq or par node are frozen too. Inherited from the parent node. Default: waiting.

success_exit_codes.description: Process exit codes that mean success, e.g. [0, 255] for "ssh host reboot". The listed codes replace the default, so list 0 too if it should also mean success. Inherited from the parent node. Default: [0].

system_envs.description: Use the environment of the runner (runtree's own for the local runner) as a base environment for the processes. Default: true.

timeout.description: The longest time that a run node may run, e.g. 90s, 30m or 1h30m (0: no limit). Then its process is stopped (Ctrl+C is typed into its terminal, SIGTERM and SIGKILL follow if it does not stop), and the node fails: it gets the status of its on_error. It is inherited: on a seq or par node it is the limit of each run node below it, not of the group. Inherited from the parent node. Default: 0.

else.patternErrorMessage: expected a duration with a unit, e.g. 90s, 30m or 1h30m (or 0: no limit)

title.description: A single line, human-readable title, displayed in the GUI. Variables can be used.

type.description: The type of the node: run (runs a command), seq (runs its sub-nodes one after the other) or par (runs its sub-nodes in parallel). It is not needed when the node has a seq or par property, and a node with include is a seq node by default. Default: run.

additionalProperties.description: Top level objects to load as sub-nodes, from this file (name) or from another file (file|name, relative to this file). A node that includes one object (without for_vars and locks) becomes that object, with its own title, description, provides and requires.

vars.description: Variables (name: value) for this node and its subtree. Values are strings or lists of strings, and can be used as {name} in other properties. Inherited from the parent node.

xlocks.description: Names of resources that are locked exclusively while the node is running or paused: no other node can lock them meanwhile. A name cannot be in the rlocks of the node too (also inherited ones). It is not inherited.

description: A runtree file: the tree object, and other top level objects that can be included.

tree.description: The root node of the tree.
